# Exact-revision notice copies

This directory retains the reviewed license copy for rquickjs-core 0.14.0, which
is still used by the rewritten script engine. `overrides.json` records the crate's
published VCS revision, declared license, original source URL and notice SHA-256.
The license text is an unmodified copy from that revision.

Copies used only by the former CUA SDK/worker package have been removed. The old
license-audit and packaging pipeline no longer exists. This directory is neither
a complete inventory of current dependencies nor evidence of a release audit.
A future package must inventory its actual locked dependencies and include their
required notices; see [release checkpoints](../../docs/releasing.md).
